page.layout: One page of text, one column. A dedication heading at the top, centred, in capitals and small capitals, over two lines. Below it, one stanza of italic verse in a single block with a decorative initial. No margin notes, running head or page number.

main_text.head: IOANNI IACOMOTO AMICO ET ECCLESIASTÆ Geneuensi.

p.i: VEre nouo quũ forte solũ noua tēporis ætas Fronde tegit, grauidóq; suo noua palmite Iam tumet, & latè spatiàs per florea rura: (gemma Dædala qualis apis flores populatur hymetti, Itque reditque vias, carptis & odora refundit Antra thymis, leuibusq; volans examina pẽnis Læta petit, rauco mulcens aluearia bombo. Haud secus Aonidūm decus ô Iacomote sororum Carmina digna legi, & clara sub luce videri Musarum chorus adstrepitans tua làbit, & vsq; Circūstat vagus, & stridulus superinuoluat alis, Mulcēdo & placidis immurmurat, ecce, susurris. Ite procul, procul hinc falsíque facessite vates, Sydereus supera surgit nam missus ab arce Vates, maiori plenus qui numine sacros Spargit ab ore sonos, ingrata silentia vobis Vestra premens, quibus est salibus meditata pro- Lasciuóque ioco, fictóq; lepore camœna. (teruis Hic gravibus permixta minis fumantia tantum Excidia, & sanctæ fata impendentia genti

page.notes: The decorative initial V is a woodcut letter, joined to "ere" as "VEre". Some abbreviations and tildes are read from a small scan and are copied as printed. No doubtful readings were marked. The line "Musarum chorus adstrepitans tua làbit" and the accent on "làbit" and "spatiàs" are as printed.
